text:
Olga M.: Heads-up: EOD batch produced a couple of bad invoices. One customer got two PDFs with the same invoice_id and several invoices are missing VAT/Tax line.
Ben K.: Which invoice_ids?
Olga M.: Samples: 2026-04-05-RD-6120 (duplicate PDF), 2026-04-05-RD-6125 (missing VAT). Generated around 21:12-21:18 UTC.
Billing Bot: invoice-service ERROR: s3_put_conflict invoice_id=2026-04-05-RD-6120 key=inv/2026/04/05/2026-04-05-RD-6120.pdf status=409
Tomas R.: I pulled reconciler logs: partition p-331 retried twice within 30s and produced two output files with identical invoice_id. Dedupe guard compared (partition, run_id) but run_id was empty for that retry.
Priya M.: The missing VAT lines look related: our tax-apply job (tax-runner) ran concurrently and for some partitions finished after reconciler, so reconciler snapshot lacked tax flags.
Ben K.: Ok immediate mitigation: pause outbound email and auto-finalize until we dedupe and re-run tax application.
Olga M.: Billing Bot, pause outbound_email for 60m and set auto_finalize=false until cleared.
Billing Bot: command accepted: outbound_email_paused=true auto_finalize=false (expires in 60m) :white_check_mark:
Tomas R.: Remediation plan: 1) run a dedupe pass removing duplicate reconciler outputs for runs with empty run_id 2) re-run tax-apply for affected partitions 3) regenerate PDFs from canonical outputs and remove stale S3 objects 4) send corrected invoices and credit memos if duplicates went out.
Priya M.: I have SQL to find invoices missing tax: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_line_items WHERE line_code='vat' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-04-05T21:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-05T21:30:00Z' HAVING COUNT(*) = 0;
Ben K.: I'll coordinate customer outreach for the duplicate PDF and missing VAT customers. Tomas post back when dedupe results are in and Priya when tax backfill is dry-run complete.
Tomas R.: Running dry-run dedupe now, will post results in ~10m. Also opening ticket INV-4469.
Olga M.: Thanks. If anyone finds more invoice_ids paste them here.
Ben K.: Add a short-term check: if reconciler outputs have run_id NULL, block finalization and alert.
Billing Bot: audit-log created ticket=INV-4469 severity=high tags=[duplicate-invoice,tax-backfill]
Priya M.: Will add ordering guard so tax-apply publishes a completion marker reconciler can check. ETA for patch: 40m.
Olga M.: Good. Keep updates in this thread.
